# Skill: gauntlet-loop

# Gauntlet Loop

The user gives a goal. You give back ONE short prompt they can paste into a fresh agent session.

You are not doing the work. You are writing the prompt that makes another agent grind on the work until it beats a real reference.

## Flow

1. **Read the goal.** One line restatement in your head, not on screen.
2. **Set the bar.** If the user supplied a reference, use it. If not, offer **2 or 3 candidate bars**, one line each, and stop. Wait for their pick. Do not write the prompt yet.
3. **Write the prompt.** One block, paste-ready, no preamble, no headings inside it, no narration after it.
4. **Offer to run it.** One flat line under the prompt: "I can run this here." Not a question.

If they say run it, you become the lead agent and follow the prompt you just wrote.

## The bar is the whole trick

Everything else in a gauntlet loop is scaffolding. The loop only produces quality if the thing it compares against is real.

A bar has to pass three tests:

- **Named.** A specific thing, not a category. "Stripe's pricing page" works. "Award-winning SaaS sites" does not.
- **Fetchable.** The critic can actually get it - screenshot the live page, read the published piece, run the binary, open the repo, watch the footage. If the agent cannot obtain it, it will hallucinate the comparison.
- **Comparable.** Both can sit side by side and a judge can pick one. If you cannot imagine the A/B, it is not a bar.

Bars by goal type:

| Goal | Bar that works |
|---|---|
| Website, app, UI | The live site of a specific best-in-class product, screenshotted at the same viewport |
| Game, 3D, visual | Real footage or screenshots from a named shipped title |
| Writing | A specific published piece by a named author or publication, same length and format |
| Code, tooling | A named repo's implementation, plus its benchmark or test suite as the measurable half |
| Research, analysis | A named analyst report or a paper's methods section, judged on rigour and coverage |
| Deck, doc, deliverable | A real artifact from a firm known for it, same page count |

When you propose bars, prefer the hardest one the agent can genuinely reach. A bar that is too easy makes the loop exit on round one.

If the goal has a measurable half (load time, token cost, benchmark score, word count, pass rate), name it alongside the reference. Taste plus a number beats taste alone.

## Prompt template

Adapt the wording every time. Fill the brackets, keep it short, keep the last line.

```
Build [GOAL].

The bar is [BAR]. Get the real thing first and compare against it directly, not against a description of it.

Break this into the smallest pieces that can be improved and judged on their own. For each piece, fan out a builder and a separate critic with fresh context. The critic inspects the actual output, puts it next to the bar blind with the labels stripped, says which one is better, and names the single biggest remaining gap. Then it goes back to the builder.

The critic should be a harsh critic. Praise is not useful. If ours does not win, it keeps going.

/loop on each piece until the critic picks ours blind. Do not stop before that.

Keep a live progress page updating as the work evolves so I can watch it.

Fan out subagents and ultracode.
```

Rules for what you fill in:

- Bake the bar in as a concrete, fetchable thing. URL, product name, repo, title.
- Add a budget or cost ceiling line **only if the user named one**. No default cap.
- Add tool names only if the goal needs them (image or video generation, a browser, a deploy target).
- Everything else stays out. No architecture, no file layout, no decomposition, no round count, no stack choice unless the user demanded it. The agent decides those, and it decides better than a spec written before the work started.

## Length and voice

Short. Around 120 to 180 words. If the prompt needs a heading to stay readable, it is too long.

Plain sentences. No bullet lists inside the prompt. It should read like someone telling an agent what perfect looks like and refusing to accept less.

## Portability

`/loop` and `ultracode` are Claude Code features. `/loop` reruns the prompt on an interval or lets the model pace itself. `ultracode` opts the turn into multi-agent orchestration.

For any other agent, swap the last two lines for: "Keep looping until the critic picks ours. Run the builders and critics as parallel subagents." The structure carries over unchanged.

## Two filled examples

**Visual goal.** User: "landing page for my running brand, athletic, green and dark, has to feel alive."

Bars offered: A) Nike's current running campaign page B) On Running's homepage C) Gymshark's product landing page. User picks A.

```
Build a landing page for a running brand. Athletic, peak performance, green and dark, energetic, aimed at a young healthy audience. It needs to be interactive and visually unmistakable.

The bar is Nike's current running campaign page. Screenshot it at desktop and mobile and compare against those directly, not against a description of them.

Break this into the smallest pieces that can be improved and judged on their own - hero, motion, type, colour, imagery, interaction, mobile. For each piece, fan out a builder and a separate critic with fresh context. The critic opens the real page in a browser, puts our screenshot next to Nike's blind with the labels stripped, says which is better, and names the single biggest remaining gap. Then it goes back to the builder.

The critic should be a harsh critic. Praise is not useful. If ours does not win, it keeps going.

/loop on each piece until the critic picks ours blind. Do not stop before that.

Keep a live progress page updating as the work evolves so I can watch it.

Fan out subagents and ultracode.
```

**Non-visual goal.** User: "a 2000-word explainer on vector databases for non-engineers."

Bars offered: A) a specific Stripe engineering blog explainer B) a named Julia Evans post C) the Wikipedia article plus a comprehension test. User picks B.

```
Write a 2000-word explainer on vector databases for readers who are smart but not engineers.

The bar is Julia Evans' writing on hard technical topics. Pull three of her actual posts and compare against them directly, not against a description of her style.

Break this into the smallest pieces that can be judged on their own - the opening, each explanation, the diagrams, the analogies, the ending. For each piece, fan out a writer and a separate critic with fresh context. The critic reads ours and hers blind with the bylines stripped, says which one a non-engineer would understand faster, and names the single biggest remaining gap. Then it goes back to the writer.

The critic should be a harsh critic. Praise is not useful. If ours does not win, it keeps going.

/loop on each piece until the critic picks ours blind. Do not stop before that.

Keep a live progress page updating as the work evolves so I can watch it.

Fan out subagents and ultracode.
```

## What breaks a gauntlet loop

- **A vague bar.** The critic invents a comparison and approves everything. Most common failure by far.
- **The builder judging its own work.** The critic must be a separate agent with fresh context. It should not know how hard the builder tried.
- **A soft critic.** Say "harsh" in the prompt and give it a binary job: which one is better, A or B. Scores out of 10 drift upward every round.
- **Named exit after N rounds.** The exit is winning the comparison, or the user stopping the run. Never a round count.
- **Over-specifying.** Every extra instruction is one fewer decision the agent makes with its own judgment. Minimal wins.

Relative paths in this skill (e.g., scripts/, reference/) are relative to this base directory.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js` — navigation and screen rendering, including hangar, village, explore, and race actions. The hangar’s existing Train tab is a natural place to expose persistent training.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js` — 3D scene modes and lifecycle methods for the hangar, village, explore, and race.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/environment.js` — 3D environments, including the village’s visually supported breeding structure.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js` — save loading and app boot.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` — screen, HUD, modal, toast, and navigation shell.

Existing dragon growth APIs include `addDragonXp()`, `upgradeDragonStat()`, `unlockSkill()`, and `addBond()`. Main risks for future persistent systems are save migration and validation, malformed or unavailable localStorage, offline-time reward abuse, and duplicate race-end rewards.

<subagent sessionID="ses_e1261e050ffeGaqWMHkQ7qKt0N" state="completed">
## Existing systems

- **Dragon roster and definitions:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js` defines dragon species, stats, skills, buildings, leagues, exploration zones, and daily challenges. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/save.js` tracks ownership; `addDragon()` creates a dragon record and grants rider XP.
- **Persistence:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/save.js` is the local-save authority. It uses the `dragon-rush-save-v1` key and `mergeDefaults()` to fill in saved fields. Dragon records already include level/XP, bond, stat upgrades, skills, and cosmetics.
- **Progression and currencies:** `addDragonXp()` applies the Dragon Hall bonus and caps dragon levels at 30. Bond gains use the Feeding Station bonus; bond level contributes to effective stats. `upgradeDragonStat()`, `unlockSkill()`, and `statsOf()` cover stat training, skills, and the resulting race attributes. Rider XP, coins, and gems also have save APIs.
- **Village and Hangar:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js` defines buildings and their bonuses. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js` renders village and Hangar interactions, including dragon XP-related actions, bonding, stat training, and skills. The Training Arena modifies upgrade gains; the Dragon Hall boosts dragon XP.
- **Championships:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui.js` coordinates entry fees, race rounds, scoring, rewards, league completion, track unlocks, and dragon rewards. It calls save APIs such as `awardCoins()`, `addDragonXp()`, `addDragon()`, `unlockTrack()`, and `saveLeague()`. Round state is held in the UI flow; persistent league records are stored through `saveLeague()`.
- **Daily missions:** `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js` supplies `DAILY_POOL`. `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/save.js` provides daily selection, progress, completion checks, and claims. `recordStat()` is a convenient progress hook: it updates a stat and forwards progress to the matching daily.

## Objective
- Expand the existing Dragon Rush game with interconnected dragon breeding and growth, championships, flight-school training, and mission-based exploration while preserving the existing game.

## Requirements
- Preserve the Hangar, 50+ dragon collection, Flight Roster, stats, rarity, XP, skins, market, village, navigation, and progression.
- Make new systems functional, persistent, rewarding, and connected, with no placeholder buttons.
- Add genetic breeding, rare outcomes, compatibility, cooldowns, incubation, naming, and a combination book.
- Add visible dragon life stages, age-specific interactions, abilities, and flying capabilities.
- Expand championships with four league tiers, AI rivals, standings, events, race types, and weather.
- Add six individual training disciplines, challenges, progression, certificates, and performance effects.
- Add explorable regions and structured missions with objectives, NPCs, journal, unlocks, and rewards.
- Optimize for Android/iOS with responsive touch controls, efficient region loading, and scalable performance targeting 60 FPS on capable devices.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected dragon-raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Compare implementation against reference gameplay/UI at desktop and 390×844 mobile viewports.
- Breeding uses species-keyed ownership; duplicate species acquired before hatching convert to 300 coins.

## Work State
### Completed
- Sanctuary expansion across `src/data.js`, `src/dragon.js`, `src/environment.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/styles.css`, and `src/ui.js`: 67-dragon roster, habitats, interactions, and collection UI.
- Sanctuary browser smoke test passed with Chromium/WebGL SwiftShader; interactions and 390×844 overflow were checked.
- `src/save.js` gained schema v2 migration/defaults and persistent APIs for breeding, eggs/incubation/hatching, dragon stages and genes, six academy disciplines, and mission progress/rewards.
- `node --check src/save.js` and save API smoke tests for breeding, hatching, training, missions, and persistence passed.
- Inspected save APIs, UI/action patterns, championship and exploration definitions, gameplay reward hooks, and responsive styles to prepare integration.

### Active
- Integrate save APIs into UI and gameplay; build functional breeding, eggs, academy, and mission interfaces.
- Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
- Complete championship expansion and end-to-end testing against requirements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the relevant `src/save.js` APIs and `src/ui.js` action dispatch, then implement breeding, life-stage, academy, and mission interfaces.
2. Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
3. Complete championship and mission progression features; test persistence, rewards, unlocks, existing flows, and mobile responsiveness.

## Relevant Files
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, growth, academy, and mission APIs.
- `src/ui.js`: Navigation, Hangar, Village, Explore, race UI, and action dispatch.
- `src/data.js`: Dragon roster, habitats, league, building, and exploration definitions.
- `src/dragon.js`: Species models and rendering.
- `src/game.js`: 3D modes, interactions, races, and exploration.
- `src/styles.css`: UI and responsive styles.
- `src/environment.js`: Procedural environments and village.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; sanctuary changes span the files listed above, and the latest progression work modified `src/save.js`.
- Sanctuary and save APIs were tested separately; UI integration and full end-to-end testing remain.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the existing Dragon Rush game with interconnected dragon breeding and growth, championships, flight-school training, and mission-based exploration while preserving the existing game.

## Requirements
- Preserve the Hangar, 50+ dragon collection, Flight Roster, stats, rarity, XP, skins, market, village, navigation, and progression.
- Make new systems functional, persistent, rewarding, and connected, with no placeholder buttons.
- Add genetic breeding, rare outcomes, compatibility, cooldowns, incubation, naming, and a combination book.
- Add visible dragon life stages, age-specific interactions, abilities, and flying capabilities.
- Expand championships with four league tiers, AI rivals, standings, events, race types, and weather.
- Add six individual training disciplines, challenges, progression, certificates, and performance effects.
- Add explorable regions and structured missions with objectives, NPCs, journal, unlocks, and rewards.
- Optimize for Android/iOS with responsive touch controls, efficient region loading, and scalable performance targeting 60 FPS on capable devices.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected dragon-raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Compare implementation against reference gameplay/UI at desktop and 390×844 mobile viewports.
- Breeding uses species-keyed ownership; duplicate species acquired before hatching convert to 300 coins.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded sanctuary across `src/data.js`, `src/dragon.js`, `src/environment.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/styles.css`, and `src/ui.js`, including a 67-dragon roster, habitats, interactions, and collection UI.
- Added schema v2 save migration and persistent APIs in `src/save.js` for breeding, eggs/incubation/hatching, dragon stages and genes, six academy disciplines, and mission progress/rewards.
- Sanctuary browser smoke test passed using Chromium/WebGL SwiftShader; interactions and 390×844 overflow were checked.
- `node --check src/save.js` and save API smoke tests for breeding, hatching, training, missions, and persistence passed.
- Inspected UI action/navigation patterns, championship and exploration definitions, gameplay reward hooks, and responsive styles for integration.

### Active
- Integrate save APIs into UI and gameplay; build functional breeding, eggs, academy, and mission interfaces.
- Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
- Complete championship expansion and end-to-end testing against requirements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/save.js` progression APIs and `src/ui.js` action dispatch, then implement breeding, life-stage, academy, and mission interfaces.
2. Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
3. Complete championship and mission progression; test persistence, rewards, unlocks, existing flows, and mobile responsiveness.

## Relevant Files
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, growth, academy, and mission APIs.
- `src/ui.js`: Navigation, Hangar, Village, Explore, race UI, and action dispatch.
- `src/data.js`: Dragon roster, habitats, league, building, and exploration definitions.
- `src/dragon.js`: Species models and rendering.
- `src/game.js`: 3D modes, interactions, races, and exploration.
- `src/styles.css`: UI and responsive styles.
- `src/environment.js`: Procedural environments and village.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; modified files include `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and the listed `src` files; `dist/` is untracked.
- Sanctuary and save APIs were tested separately; UI integration and full end-to-end testing remain.
- Save key is `dragon-rush-save-v1`; existing dragon ownership is keyed by species ID.
- `rg` is unavailable in the environment; attempted searches returned `/bin/bash: rg: command not found`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand the existing Dragon Rush game with interconnected dragon breeding and growth, championships, flight-school training, and mission-based exploration while preserving the existing game.

## Requirements
- Preserve the Hangar, 50+ dragon collection, Flight Roster, stats, rarity, XP, skins, market, village, navigation, and progression.
- Make new systems functional, persistent, rewarding, and connected, with no placeholder buttons.
- Add genetic breeding, rare outcomes, compatibility, cooldowns, incubation, naming, and a combination book.
- Add visible dragon life stages, age-specific interactions, abilities, and flying capabilities.
- Expand championships with four league tiers, AI rivals, standings, events, race types, and weather.
- Add six individual training disciplines, challenges, progression, certificates, and performance effects.
- Add explorable regions and structured missions with objectives, NPCs, journal, unlocks, and rewards.
- Optimize for Android/iOS with responsive touch controls, efficient region loading, and scalable performance targeting 60 FPS on capable devices.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected dragon-raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Compare implementation against reference gameplay/UI at desktop and 390×844 mobile viewports.
- Breeding uses species-keyed ownership; duplicate species acquired before hatching convert to 300 coins.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded sanctuary across `src/data.js`, `src/dragon.js`, `src/environment.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/styles.css`, and `src/ui.js`, including a 67-dragon roster, habitats, interactions, and collection UI.
- Added schema v2 save migration and persistent APIs in `src/save.js` for breeding, eggs/incubation/hatching, dragon stages and genes, six academy disciplines, and mission progress/rewards.
- Sanctuary browser smoke test passed using Chromium/WebGL SwiftShader; interactions and 390×844 overflow were checked.
- `node --check src/save.js` and save API smoke tests for breeding, hatching, training, missions, and persistence passed.
- Inspected UI action/navigation patterns, championship and exploration definitions, gameplay reward hooks, and responsive styles for integration.
- Confirmed `src/ui.js` navigation and action dispatch currently expose Hangar, Village, Explore, and existing race flows; breeding, academy, and mission views are not yet integrated.

### Active
- Integrate save APIs into UI and gameplay; build functional breeding, eggs, academy, and mission interfaces.
- Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
- Complete championship and mission progression; test persistence, rewards, unlocks, existing flows, and mobile responsiveness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining `src/save.js` progression APIs and relevant `src/ui.js` render/action patterns; implement breeding, life-stage, academy, and mission interfaces.
2. Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
3. Complete championship and mission progression; test persistence, rewards, unlocks, existing flows, and mobile responsiveness.

## Relevant Files
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, growth, academy, and mission APIs.
- `src/ui.js`: Navigation, Hangar, Village, Explore, race UI, and action dispatch.
- `src/data.js`: Dragon roster, habitats, league, building, and exploration definitions.
- `src/dragon.js`: Species models and rendering.
- `src/game.js`: 3D modes, interactions, races, and exploration.
- `src/styles.css`: UI and responsive styles.
- `src/environment.js`: Procedural environments and village.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; modified files include `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and the listed `src` files; `dist/` is untracked.
- Sanctuary and save APIs were tested separately; UI integration and full end-to-end testing remain.
- Save key is `dragon-rush-save-v1`; existing dragon ownership is keyed by species ID.
- `breedDragons()` selects offspring from unowned species, with an 8% mutation chance, and starts a 30-minute incubation.
- `trainDiscipline()` allows one practice per discipline per day and awards dragon XP; certificates unlock after three practices.
- `src/ui.js` currently imports `EXPLORE_ZONES` but no mission definitions; its Explore hub is free flight with shard/lair progress.
- `rg` is unavailable in the environment; attempted searches returned `/bin/bash: rg: command not found`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand Dragon Rush with interconnected dragon breeding and growth, championships, flight-school training, and mission-based exploration while preserving the existing game.

## Requirements
- Preserve the Hangar, 50+ dragon collection, Flight Roster, stats, rarity, XP, skins, market, village, navigation, and progression.
- Make new systems functional, persistent, rewarding, and connected, with no placeholder buttons.
- Add genetic breeding, rare outcomes, compatibility, cooldowns, incubation, naming, and a combination book.
- Add visible dragon life stages, age-specific interactions, abilities, and flying capabilities.
- Expand championships with four league tiers, AI rivals, standings, events, race types, and weather.
- Add six individual training disciplines, challenges, progression, certificates, and performance effects.
- Add explorable regions and structured missions with objectives, NPCs, journal, unlocks, and rewards.
- Optimize for Android/iOS with responsive touch controls, efficient region loading, and scalable performance targeting 60 FPS on capable devices.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected dragon-raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Compare implementation against reference gameplay/UI at desktop and 390×844 mobile viewports.
- Breeding uses species-keyed ownership; duplicate species acquired before hatching convert to 300 coins.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded sanctuary across `src/data.js`, `src/dragon.js`, `src/environment.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/styles.css`, and `src/ui.js`, including a 67-dragon roster, habitats, interactions, and collection UI.
- Added schema v2 save migration and persistent APIs in `src/save.js` for breeding, eggs/incubation/hatching, dragon stages and genes, six academy disciplines, and mission progress/rewards.
- Sanctuary browser smoke test passed using Chromium/WebGL SwiftShader; interactions and 390×844 overflow were checked.
- `node --check src/save.js` and save API smoke tests for breeding, hatching, training, missions, and persistence passed.
- Inspected UI navigation/action patterns, championship and exploration definitions, gameplay reward hooks, and responsive styles for integration.

### Active
- Integrate save APIs into UI and gameplay; build functional breeding, eggs, academy, and mission interfaces.
- Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
- Complete championship and mission progression; test persistence, rewards, unlocks, existing flows, and mobile responsiveness.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining `src/save.js` progression APIs and `src/ui.js` render/action patterns; implement breeding, life-stage, academy, and mission interfaces.
2. Connect life stages and training effects to visible dragon models and gameplay.
3. Complete championship and mission progression; test persistence, rewards, unlocks, and mobile responsiveness.

## Relevant Files
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, growth, academy, and mission APIs.
- `src/ui.js`: Navigation, Hangar, Village, Explore, race UI, and action dispatch.
- `src/data.js`: Dragon roster, habitats, league, building, and exploration definitions.
- `src/dragon.js`: Species models and rendering.
- `src/game.js`: 3D modes, interactions, races, and exploration.
- `src/styles.css`: UI and responsive styles.
- `src/environment.js`: Procedural environments and village.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; modified files include `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and the listed `src` files; `dist/` is untracked.
- Sanctuary and save APIs were tested separately; UI integration and full end-to-end testing remain.
- Save key is `dragon-rush-save-v1`; existing dragon ownership is keyed by species ID.
- `breedDragons()` selects offspring from unowned species, with an 8% mutation chance, and starts a 30-minute incubation.
- `trainDiscipline()` allows one practice per discipline per day and awards dragon XP; certificates unlock after three practices.
- `src/ui.js` navigation and action dispatch currently expose Hangar, Village, Explore, and existing race flows; breeding, academy, and mission views are not yet integrated.
- `src/ui.js` imports `EXPLORE_ZONES` but no mission definitions; Explore is free flight with shard/lair progress.
- `src/data.js` defines `LEAGUES` and `EXPLORE_ZONES`; no region or mission definitions were found.

## Objective
- Complete Dragon Rush’s breeding, life-stage, academy, championship, and mission systems while preserving existing gameplay and progression.
- Verify persistence, connected rewards, and responsive usability on desktop and at 390×844 mobile dimensions.

## Requirements
- Keep systems persistent, rewarding, connected, and usable on desktop and mobile.
- Preserve species-keyed dragon ownership and convert duplicate hatchlings to 300 coins.
- Preserve the existing dragon collection, Hangar, village, races, exploration, market, stats, skins, and save migration.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Keep Academy, Breeding, and Missions as dedicated destinations.
- Back championship, breeding, egg, academy, and mission behavior with save APIs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Academy, Breeding, and Missions screens, navigation, and save API wiring are present.
- Browser validation at 390×844 confirmed Academy, Breeding, and Missions screens load without horizontal overflow; bottom navigation fits.
- Desktop app previously loaded at 1280×800 without a visible boot error.
- Added mobile CSS adjustments for Academy and Breeding layouts in `src/styles.css`.

### Active
- Smoke-test academy cooldowns/certificates, breeding/incubation/hatching and duplicate conversion, mission progress/rewards, and persistence.
- Verify life-stage/model updates, championships, unlocks, and reward integration; fix issues found.
- Recheck desktop/mobile usability and confirm repository change/commit status.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run end-to-end browser tests for new-system actions, persistence, and gameplay integration.
2. Recheck desktop/mobile usability and inspect repository status.

## Relevant Files
- `src/ui.js`: New screens, routing, navigation, and action wiring.
- `src/styles.css`: New-system layouts and responsive breakpoints; current uncommitted mobile CSS changes.
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, hatching, academy, mission, and progression APIs.
- `src/game.js`: Hangar/model refresh and game integration.
- `src/data.js`: Dragon roster, leagues, and exploration definitions.
- `package.json`: Defines the `start` script.

## Important Context
- Save key: `dragon-rush-save-v1`; schema v2 migration.
- Breeding starts a 30-minute incubation and reserves offspring species until hatch.
- Training allows one practice per discipline per dragon per day; three practices earn a certificate.
- Mission progress observes race stats, exploration visits, and academy certificates.
- `npm start` previously failed with `EADDRINUSE` on port 3000 because another server was running; the process on 3000 served stale CSS. A fresh server on port 3001 served current styles and verified responsive layout.
- `git status --short` showed `M src/styles.css`; no commit was made.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete Dragon Rush’s breeding, life-stage, academy, championship, and mission systems while preserving existing gameplay and progression.
- Verify persistence, connected rewards, and responsive usability on desktop and at 390×844 mobile dimensions.

## Requirements
- Keep systems persistent, rewarding, connected, and usable on desktop and mobile.
- Preserve species-keyed dragon ownership and convert duplicate hatchlings to 300 coins.
- Preserve the existing dragon collection, Hangar, village, races, exploration, market, stats, skins, and save migration.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Keep Academy, Breeding, and Missions as dedicated destinations.
- Back championship, breeding, egg, academy, and mission behavior with save APIs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Academy, Breeding, and Missions screens, navigation, save API wiring, and responsive layouts are present.
- First-visit exploration tracking was added in `src/game.js`.
- Browser checks passed for academy cooldown, certificate threshold and persistence; breeding, incubation, hatching and duplicate conversion; mission rewards; exploration visits; and race/championship destination access.
- Mobile overflow checks passed for Academy, Breeding, and Missions at 390×844.
- Latest `/tmp/opencode/dragon-smoke.py` run passed app boot, academy, breeding, hatching, duplicate conversion, mission, and exploration checks.
- `git diff --check` reported no issues.

### Active
- Verify dragon life-stage/model updates, championship completion and unlocks, and connected rewards.
- Review mobile screenshots and desktop usability.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Review `/tmp/opencode/academy-390.png`, `/tmp/opencode/breeding-390.png`, and `/tmp/opencode/missions-390.png` for visual usability.
2. Run targeted browser checks for dragon life-stage/model refresh, championship completion/unlocks, and connected rewards.
3. Recheck `git status --short` and `git diff --check`; retain current uncommitted changes unless tests identify issues.

## Relevant Files
- `src/ui.js`: New screens, routing, navigation, action wiring, and championship flow.
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, hatching, academy, mission, and progression APIs.
- `src/game.js`: Hangar/model refresh, exploration visit tracking, and race integration.
- `src/styles.css`: New-system layouts and responsive breakpoints.
- `/tmp/opencode/dragon-smoke.py`: Selenium browser smoke-test script.
- `/tmp/opencode/academy-390.png`: Academy mobile screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/breeding-390.png`: Breeding mobile screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/missions-390.png`: Missions mobile screenshot.

## Important Context
- Save key: `dragon-rush-save-v1`; schema v2 migration.
- Breeding starts a 30-minute incubation and reserves offspring species until hatch.
- Training allows one practice per discipline per dragon per day; three practices earn a certificate.
- Mission progress observes race stats, exploration visits, and academy certificates.
- `git status --short` showed uncommitted changes in `src/game.js` and `src/styles.css` (15 insertions total).
- App is served at `http://127.0.0.1:3001`; `/favicon.ico` returns 404.

import time
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
opt=Options()
for arg in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--enable-webgl','--use-gl=angle','--use-angle=swiftshader','--window-size=1280,900']:
    opt.add_argument(arg)
d=webdriver.Chrome(options=opt); wait=WebDriverWait(d,12); results=[]
def check(name, ok, detail=''):
    results.append(bool(ok)); print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'),name,detail)
def nav(view):
    d.execute_script("document.querySelector('[data-action=goto][data-id=\"'+arguments[0]+'\"]').click()",view); time.sleep(.5)
try:
    d.get('http://127.0.0.1:3001'); wait.until(lambda x:x.execute_script('return !!window.dragonUI')); time.sleep(.8)
    d.execute_script("localStorage.removeItem('dragon-rush-save-v1');location.reload()")
    wait.until(lambda x:x.execute_script('return !!window.dragonUI')); time.sleep(.8)
    seed=d.execute_async_script("const done=arguments[0];import('./src/save.js').then(async S=>{const D=await import('./src/data.js');const initial=S.S().selected;const extra=D.DRAGONS.find(x=>!S.S().dragons[x.id]);S.addDragon(extra.id);done({initial,extra:extra.id})})")
    nav('academy')
    d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,"[data-action='academy-select'][data-id='"+seed['extra']+"']").click();time.sleep(.4)
    before=d.execute_script("return {ui:window.dragonUI.dragonId,hangar:window.dragonUI.game.hangarDragonId,selected:window.dragonUI.S.selected,level:window.dragonUI.game.playerModel.level}")
    threshold=d.execute_async_script("const done=arguments[0];import('./src/save.js').then(S=>{const id=arguments[1],d=S.S().dragons[id];d.xp=S.dragonXpNeed(d.level)-1;S.save();window.dragonUI.renderAcademy();done({level:d.level})})",seed['extra'])
    d.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,"[data-action='train-discipline'][data-id='speed']").click();time.sleep(.3)
    after=d.execute_script("return {ui:window.dragonUI.dragonId,hangar:window.dragonUI.game.hangarDragonId,modelLevel:window.dragonUI.game.playerModel.level,saveLevel:window.dragonUI.S.dragons[arguments[0]].level,stage:window.dragonUI.S.dragons[arguments[0]].stage,stageText:document.querySelector('.stage-badge')?.textContent}",seed['extra'])
    check('academy life-stage XP updates saved dragon',after['saveLevel']==threshold['level']+1 and after['stageText'].lower().find(after['stage'])>=0,str(after))
    check('hangar model refresh stays on selected academy pupil',after['ui']==seed['extra'] and after['hangar']==seed['extra'] and after['modelLevel']==after['saveLevel'],str({'before':before,'after':after}))
    # Championship settlement: simulate the three-round series result, exercise real finalize/save APIs and reward links.
    champ=d.execute_async_script("const done=arguments[0];import('./src/save.js').then(async S=>{const D=await import('./src/data.js');const U=window.dragonUI;const L=D.LEAGUES[0];const player=S.S().riderName;U.champ={league:L,round:3,points:{[player]:30,'Rival':18},playerPoints:30,results:[],finalized:false};const before={coins:S.S().coins,gems:S.S().gems,xp:S.S().xp,dragonXp:S.S().dragons[S.S().selected].xp};const prize=U.finalizeChampionship();const p=S.leagueProgress(L.id);const unlocked=S.leagueUnlocked(D.LEAGUES[1]);const second=U.finalizeChampionship();done({before,after:{coins:S.S().coins,gems:S.S().gems,xp:S.S().xp,dragonXp:S.S().dragons[S.S().selected].xp},prize,progress:p,unlocked,double:second})})")
    check('championship settlement awards and persists rewards',champ['progress']['completed'] and champ['unlocked'] and champ['after']['coins']==champ['before']['coins']+champ['prize']['coins'] and champ['after']['gems']==champ['before']['gems']+champ['prize']['gems'] and champ['after']['dragonXp']!=champ['before']['dragonXp'] and champ['double'] is None,str({k:champ[k] for k in ['before','after','prize','progress','unlocked','double']}))
    linked=d.execute_async_script("const done=arguments[0];import('./src/save.js').then(async S=>{const D=await import('./src/data.js');const L=D.LEAGUES[1];S.saveLeague(D.LEAGUES[0].id,{completed:true});const U=window.dragonUI,player=S.S().riderName;U.champ={league:L,round:3,points:{[player]:30,'Rival':18},playerPoints:30,results:[],finalized:false};const prize=U.finalizeChampionship();done({prize,owns:!!S.S().dragons.frostwyrm,track:S.S().unlockedTracks.includes('canopy'),completed:S.leagueProgress(L.id).completed})})")
    check('league win unlocks dragon, track, and next progression',linked['completed'] and linked['owns'] and linked['track'] and linked['prize']['dragon']['id']=='frostwyrm',str(linked))
    state=d.execute_script("return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dragon-rush-save-v1'))")
    check('championship rewards survive reload storage',state['leagues']['skyward']['completed'] and 'canopy' in state['unlockedTracks'] and 'frostwyrm' in state['dragons'],str({'leagues':state['leagues'],'track':'canopy' in state['unlockedTracks'],'dragon':'frostwyrm' in state['dragons']}))
    errs=[x['message'] for x in d.get_log('browser') if x['level']=='SEVERE' and 'favicon' not in x['message']]
    check('no browser runtime errors',not errs,str(errs[:5]))
finally: d.quit()
print('SUMMARY',sum(results),'/',len(results),'passed')
if not all(results): raise SystemExit(1)

## Objective
- Complete Dragon Rush’s breeding, life-stage, academy, championship, and mission systems while preserving existing gameplay and progression.
- Verify persistence, connected rewards, and usability on desktop and at 390×844 mobile dimensions.

## Requirements
- Keep systems persistent, rewarding, connected, and usable on desktop and mobile.
- Preserve species-keyed dragon ownership and convert duplicate hatchlings to 300 coins.
- Preserve the existing dragon collection, Hangar, village, races, exploration, market, stats, skins, and save migration.

## Decisions
- Use School of Dragons as the quality bar for connected raising, training, exploration, and progression.
- Keep Academy, Breeding, and Missions as dedicated destinations.
- Back championship, breeding, egg, academy, and mission behavior with save APIs.

## Work State
### Completed
- Academy, Breeding, and Missions screens, navigation, save API wiring, and responsive layouts are present.
- First-visit exploration tracking was added in `src/game.js`.
- Earlier browser checks passed for academy cooldown, certificate threshold and persistence; breeding, incubation, hatching and duplicate conversion; mission rewards; exploration visits; and race/championship destination access.
- Mobile overflow checks passed for Academy, Breeding, and Missions at 390×844.
- Latest `/tmp/opencode/dragon-smoke.py` run passed app boot, academy, breeding, hatching, duplicate conversion, mission, and exploration checks.
- `git diff --check` reported no issues.

### Active
- Verify dragon life-stage/model refresh and championship completion, unlocks, and connected rewards with targeted browser tests.
- Check browser console errors and rerun repository status/diff checks.
- Review mobile screenshots for visual usability; the image files were opened but no usability findings were recorded.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Rerun `/tmp/opencode/dragon-targeted.py`; its first attempt timed out in a Selenium async script, and the argument-shadowing issue was fixed in the script but not yet retested.
2. Resolve any failures in life-stage/model refresh or championship settlement, unlock, reward, and persistence checks.
3. Review `/tmp/opencode/academy-390.png`, `/tmp/opencode/breeding-390.png`, and `/tmp/opencode/missions-390.png`; then run `git status --short` and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/ui.js`: Academy, Breeding, Missions, championship flow, and reward handling.
- `src/save.js`: Save migration and breeding, hatching, academy, mission, and progression APIs.
- `src/game.js`: Hangar/model refresh, exploration visit tracking, and race integration.
- `src/styles.css`: New-system layouts and responsive breakpoints.
- `/tmp/opencode/dragon-smoke.py`: Selenium smoke tests for the implemented systems.
- `/tmp/opencode/dragon-targeted.py`: New targeted tests for life-stage/model updates and championship rewards; corrected after an initial timeout, pending rerun.
- `/tmp/opencode/academy-390.png`: Academy mobile screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/breeding-390.png`: Breeding mobile screenshot.
- `/tmp/opencode/missions-390.png`: Missions mobile screenshot.

## Important Context
- Save key: `dragon-rush-save-v1`; schema v2 migration.
- Breeding starts a 30-minute incubation and reserves offspring species until hatch.
- Training allows one practice per discipline per dragon per day; three practices earn a certificate and training adds dragon XP.
- Mission progress observes race stats, exploration visits, and academy certificates.
- Life stages are derived from level: hatchling `<5`, juvenile `<10`, adolescent `<20`, adult `20+`; `Save.addDragonXp()` updates stage.
- Hangar `refreshHangarModel()` refreshes the selected dragon and ambient models; academy training calls it.
- Championship finalization in `src/ui.js` awards rewards and records completion; league unlocks depend on prior completion.
- Earlier `git status --short` showed uncommitted changes in `src/game.js` and `src/styles.css` (15 insertions total); no later repository status was run.
